entities.name: Iraqi nationalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Idea and movement that defends the interests of the iraqi nation as a single political entity, in particular, the conquest and maintenance of the nation's sovereignty over historical lands of part of mesopotamia. Iraqi nationalism is a political ideology with roots in Asia.
